title: Get Shorty
tagline: Collect the debt. Pitch the dip.
about: A Miami loan shark goes to Hollywood to collect a debt and ends up producing a movie.
cue: Serve the mains when Chili starts pitching his movie idea.
faces: Table 5, out on the palm side. Pitches all day.

Cut the cucumber into batons and pull the cos into leaves.Stand the vegetables up in glasses of ice and serve with the green goddess in a bowl.MainsChili's steak fritesSirloin seared hard, red wine and shallot butter, double-fried frites.He knows how this scene goes.How to make it1kg potatoes1 L neutral oil, for frying800g sirloin steaks (4)2 shallots, chopped150ml red wine50g cold buttersalt and pepper, to tasteCut the potatoes into thin frites and fry in the neutral oil at 140°C for 5 minutes, then rest.Season the steaks and sear hard for 3 minutes a side, then rest.Sweat the shallots in the pan fat, add the wine and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in the butter.Fry the frites again in the oil at 185°C until crisp.Slice the steak and spoon the sauce over.SweetsB-movie popcorn sundaeVanilla ice cream, hot fudge, caramel corn, salted peanuts.Half a million cheaper than a script.How to make it40g popcorn kernels50g butter80g brown sugar100g dark chocolate100ml cream8 scoops of vanilla ice cream50g salted peanutsPop the popcorn kernels.Melt the butter with the brown sugar, toss through the popcorn and bake at 150°C for 10 minutes to set.Melt the chocolate with the cream for hot fudge.Scoop ice cream into four bowls, pour over the fudge and top with popcorn and peanuts.DrinksActing lesson Bloody MaryVodka, tomato, lemon, a little heat, a celery stick.House rule no. 1: eyes up.How to make it180ml vodka480ml tomato juice40ml lemon juiceWorcestershire sauce, to tastehot sauce, to tastecelery salt and pepper, to taste4 celery sticks1 bag icePut a share of vodka, tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice.Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times.Strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick.
